title: Disabled session capture exposes deterministic replica staleness
requirement: With automatic session capture disabled, an immediate Eventual read from a delayed replica can return a plain NotFound before replication converges.

hostedEmulatorGatewayV1.reason: A fixed replication delay deterministically exposes the stale replica.

hostedEmulatorGatewayV2.reason: A fixed replication delay deterministically exposes the stale replica.

azureLive.reason: Live replication may converge before the first read, so immediate staleness is not a service contract.
